GLM-5.2.raw_difference_interpretation: pretty-printed JSON versus compact JSON only

cross_model_observation.free_form: All three models produced six byte-distinct free-form states from the same evidence in V4.
cross_model_observation.typed: All three models collapse to exactly one canonical JSON semantic state across six draws in V5; Qwen is also byte-identical across all six raw outputs, while GLM and DeepSeek differ only by JSON whitespace/pretty-printing.
cross_model_observation.semantic_boundary: The corrected V4 free-form prompt already retained all three core reusable primitives and excluded P4_LOCAL_ONLY in 6/6 draws for all models. V5 therefore does not establish an additional coarse semantic-accuracy gain over V4; it establishes a large reduction in representational/state-realization variability under a typed interface on this synthetic package.

mechanism_interpretation: Supports state-interface/serialization sensitivity as a plausible contributor to regeneration variability. It does not establish downstream utility improvement, population variance reduction, or superiority of a typed compiler on real E2 tasks.
next_high_value_falsifier: Hold a future actor and synthetic task panel fixed while varying only the frozen persistent state (maximally different V4 free-form realizations versus the canonical V5 typed state) to test whether representational state variation propagates into behavior. Freeze that actor-consumption panel prospectively before execution.
